record.question: According to B Malinowski,:
options: Magic has many superstitions and is therefore overcome by religion and science as society progresses.
Magic is usually done to cause harm, religion is used to bring harmony, and science bridges the gap between the two.
Religion, magic and science can simultaneously coexist in society as they all have the similar function of fulfilling human needs.
Religion and magic exist in eternal conflict of ideology and practices while science exists on a different and separate plane.
